name: Lionel O27 Tubular
description: Lionel O27 tubular track is the original light-profile O-gauge sectional system, dating to the 1930s and still in production. Standard pieces are tinplate stamped-steel tubular rails on stamped-steel ties. The 'O27' designator originally referred to the diameter of the tightest standard curve circle (27 in). The native straight is 8.875 in long (8 7/8 in); the native curve is 8.625 in along the centerline and sweeps 22.5 deg, so 16 sections form a 27 in nominal-diameter circle. Wider O42 and O54 curves are also produced on the same tie height. Half-straights, half-curves, switches, and 90 deg crossings round out the system. O27 is electrically and mechanically compatible with Lionel O tubular but is shorter in tie height; many users transition to FasTrack via the dedicated transition pin set.

pieces.label: 8 7/8" straight (O27)
pieces.notes: Standard O27 straight; 8.875 in = 225.425 mm. Sometimes also referenced as 8 7/8 in.

pieces.label: 4 5/16" half straight (O27)
pieces.notes: Half of an O27 straight. Lionel publishes this as 4 5/16 in (4.3125 in = 109.5375 mm). Note that this differs from a true half (4.4375 in) by ~1/8 in to allow for joiner overlap; the published nominal is used.

pieces.label: 5 5/8" straight (O27 fitter)
pieces.notes: 5.625 in = 142.875 mm. Often called the 'half-curve straight' because its length equals the chord/length used to substitute one O27 curve in certain layout adjustments.

pieces.label: 1 3/4" straight (O27 fitter)
pieces.notes: Short fitter straight, 1.75 in = 44.45 mm. SKU not fully confirmed in this build; see markdown notes.

pieces.label: O27 curve (27" diameter)
pieces.notes: O27 = 27 in nominal diameter; centerline radius 13.5 in = 342.9 mm. 16 sections per circle (22.5 deg each). length_mm = 2*pi*342.9*22.5/360 = 134.696 mm (centerline arc per schema rule). Marketing literature sometimes lists the section as ~8 5/8 in; that figure is the outer-rail / overall-tie-length dimension and is not the centerline arc.

pieces.label: O27 half curve
pieces.notes: Half of an O27 curve; 11.25 deg sweep at 13.5 in centerline radius. SKU not fully confirmed; see markdown notes.

pieces.label: O42 curve (42" diameter)
pieces.notes: O42 = 42 in nominal diameter; centerline radius 21 in = 533.4 mm. 16 sections per circle. length_mm = 2*pi*533.4*22.5/360 = 209.461 mm (centerline arc per schema rule).

pieces.label: O54 curve (54" diameter)
pieces.notes: O54 = 54 in nominal diameter; centerline radius 27 in = 685.8 mm. 16 sections per circle. length_mm = 2*pi*685.8*22.5/360 = 269.342 mm (centerline arc per schema rule).

pieces.label: O27 manual turnout, left
pieces.notes: Diverging route follows an O27 curve (22.5 deg). Straight route is the equivalent of one O27 straight (8.875 in = 225.425 mm).

pieces.label: O27 remote turnout, left
pieces.notes: Solenoid-controlled remote variant; same geometry as the manual O27 turnout.

pieces.label: O27 90 degree crossing
pieces.notes: Both routes equal one O27 straight (8.875 in).

pieces.label: O27 45 degree crossing
pieces.notes: Both routes equal one O27 straight along centerline. SKU not fully confirmed; see markdown notes.

pieces.label: O27 bumper
pieces.notes: End-of-track bumper. Effective length along main route not published by Lionel; left null.

data_quality_note: Generated 2026-05-05 by an agent without working WebFetch/WebSearch access. Geometry math (length_mm = in*25.4; curve length = 2*pi*r*deg/360) is hand-computed and high-confidence. Product codes (SKUs) and source_url values are derived from training-data recall and were NOT live-verified. source_verified_at is null on every piece until a session with web access re-checks the catalog.
